generation.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one original Heroes of Might and Magic III hero portrait master, to be reduced to 58x64 and a face crop 48x32 pixels. Subject: Irelia from League of Legends, recognizable serious Ionian young adult woman, long dark blue-black hair, narrow silver pointed temple crown, red silk head ribbon, silver shoulder armor and red-and-violet cloth, disciplined determined face. Background richly mottled burgundy red and ochre autumn leaves, textured colored paint. Close compact head-and-shoulders portrait, entire hair/hat silhouette within frame, face large and readable, three-quarter view. Painterly late-1990s fantasy game portrait, textured hand-painted oil miniature, natural anatomy and individual facial planes, strong warm light from upper left, crisp readable eyes and silhouette, restrained metallic highlights. Original composition, not a copy of a splash painting. No anime, no chibi, no glossy modern key art, no photoreal photograph, no typography, no border, no watermark. One character only, square composition.
